text:
When the count rate from a radioactive source is measured, background radiation is taken into
account.
Which option shows only examples of nuclear background radiation?
A
alpha-particles from radon gas and gamma radiation from space
B
alpha-particles from radon gas and infrared radiation from the Sun
C
gamma radiation from the Sun and microwaves from satellites
D
microwaves from satellites and X-rays from hospitals

options.label: A
options.text: alpha-particles from radon gas and gamma radiation from space

options.label: B
options.text: alpha-particles from radon gas and infrared radiation from the Sun

options.label: C
options.text: gamma radiation from the Sun and microwaves from satellites

options.label: D
options.text: microwaves from satellites and X-rays from hospitals
